title: Potent Drugs
subtitle: —An ounce of gold, or its equivalent in dollars.

items.text: Potent Drugs

items.speaker: Letter
items.text: "In conclusion, Researcher X's continued study on mechanical devices poses significant safety risks …"

items.speaker: Letter
items.text: "It is recommended that Researcher X undergo a thorough investigation for compliance, along with all of his mechanical devices …"
Neat handwriting, clear argumentation. It makes for another fine addition to the pile of over thirty other similar complaints.
It seems Mesmer Jr. has put no small effort into her report. Now someone else has to work overtime to follow them through.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Relax! There are no safety concerns with any of my devices!

items.speaker: X
items.text: See, it will all run automatically as soon as you sit down here. And the result is …

items.speaker: X
items.text: Aha, a flower!
Thankfully, the subject of her investigation is both cooperative and enthusiastic in demonstrating his work.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Next, let me present an experiment that uses marbles to turn off a set of lights after a thirty-minute delay! Oh, and then I'll have to show you my machine that uses matches and fishing line to automate watering plants! And then …

items.speaker: X
items.text: Huh? Leaving so soon? There's still a ton of apparatuses and blueprints I haven't shown you yet!
A love of science is hard to criticize.
But excessive passion in any pursuit can spiral into catastrophe.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Are you certain you don't want to review my work again? This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Uh … Timekeeper?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: You seem out of breath …? Is someone chasing you?
Sonetto?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Sorry, Mesmer Jr. said you might be here. I just came to check in.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Did I … disturb you?
In fact, she has arrived just in time. Unfortunately, so does another.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Hey, Vertin! Where were you off to? I thought you and I were supposed to be having fun doing a "systemic review" of my work.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Hello, Mr. X.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Oh, hi, Ms. Sonetto!

items.speaker: X
items.text: I suppose your being here must mean we have a new mission?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Precisely. The Foundation needs us to relocate an arcanist to headquarters before the "Storm."

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: The risk for this operation is relatively low. Timekeeper, you've been given free rein to designate your team members for this task.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: It does seem that this mission's target is rather tricky. Madam Z suggests that you bring along a team member who excels at communication …

items.speaker: X
items.text: Hey, why are you looking at me like that?

items.speaker: X
items.text: I can't believe you dragged me out here.

items.speaker: X
items.text: I'd love to help, but you know field missions aren't my strong suit. I'm more of a laboratory rat, you know?
You won't be going back to the laboratory before the investigation ends.
items.edge_label: 审查结束前不能让你回实验室

items.speaker: X
items.text: Yes, yes, yes ... I will do whatever I can to assist!

items.speaker: X
items.text: But aren't most arcanists known for their difficult personalities? What's so special about this guy?
Sonetto flips through the mission book.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Our target is Vlad Wilson. Born into a family of potion-makers, he is currently the sole owner of Wilson Pharmaceuticals. It also says he seems to be tied up in some kind of medical dispute.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: You're originally American, aren't you, Mr. X? Are you familiar with the name?

items.speaker: X
items.text: Uhm ... I grew up in the slums, Sonetto. Not really the kind of place you just bump into pharmaceutical moguls.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Really, I don't see how I can help with this mission.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Maybe you should consider grabbing someone else? I can head back.
We could let you out here, if you'd like.

branch.speaker: X
branch.text: No, no, I didn't mean it that way ... Please don't kick me out in the middle of nowhere.

items.text: I caution you to remember the subject of your laboratory privileges.
items.edge_label: 还记得实验室的使用权吗？

branch.speaker: X
branch.text: Of course. Aha, I was only joking.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Hm … So back to the case, how did he get into this medical dispute? As far as lawsuits go, I've heard these types of cases are notoriously tough.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Got any more information in that book of yours?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: The details of the dispute were not included in the mission book, nor did Madam Z say anything. Perhaps it is a personal matter for Mr. Wilson.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: It is immaterial to our mission. We only need to coordinate with him about the transfer.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Yes, I just hope things go smoothly.
The car comes to a sudden stop. Still a long distance to go to the target location.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: What is it? An ambush?!

items.speaker: X
items.text: No, it seems to be a protest.
Someone bangs on the car window frantically.

items.speaker: Crowd
items.text: Boycott Wilson Pharmaceuticals!

items.speaker: Crowd
items.text: Stop the patent acquisition!!! Give us back our medication!!!

items.speaker: Crowd
items.text: Wilson Pharmaceuticals is a price-gouging monster!!!
Though they move to roll up the windows, streams of flyers are pushed in before it closes up entirely.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Oh ... You were right, Ms. Sonetto. This whole medical dispute doesn't seem to have anything to do with our mission or arcanum in general.

items.speaker: X
items.text: But I think I've figured out what makes this Wilson guy so tricky.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Take a look for yourself.
Sonetto takes the flyer.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Vlad Wilson recently listed 49 drug patents for sale … One of which is the only treatment for a copper metabolism disorder …

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: And if the proposed sale goes through … The price will be increased from $1 per capsule to …
TO BE CONTINUED…
